prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns (adoption redesign), sign-in hints (sign_in hint), home waiting info (home wait_info), and home notifications (home notification) were helpful, each yielding winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish new_screen) consistently hurt performance or caused early stops.
Finish screen hints (finish hint), home redesigns (home redesign), and home hints (home hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but were too low for several surprising winning layout and hint changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with a prominent spotlight preview stage for selecting pet companions. (why: Adoption steps are highly effective (92.6% conversion), and visual stage layouts provide stronger pet immersion during friend selection.)
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive pet quickstart sandbox screen: Add an interactive quickstart sandbox screen before final home launch to teach users desktop pet interaction controls. (why: Finish completion drops to 69.9% with a long 395s median time, and support received multiple complaints about unclear controls for hiding and interacting with pets.)
2: [home, redesign] Split layout redesign for desktop waiting screen: Rebuild the waiting screen with a split layout pairing real-time background setup status with interactive tip cards. (why: Home waiting screen takes a long median time (201s), and split layouts provide clear visual separation between status and guidance.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet companion quiz interactive flow: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pet selection to recommend matching pet types based on user desktop habits. (why: Enhancing adoption personalization speeds up selection (mean adoption step time is currently 1017s) and boosts user attachment.)
4: [finish, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a full bleed hero layout highlighting the pet ready state and controls. (why: The final onboarding step drops to 69.9% completion; immersive full bleed visual layouts create a more decisive call to action.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account session persistence hint on sign-in screen: Display an explicit helper hint explaining that sign-in locks saved pets to your account across reinstalls and log-ins. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-authenticating or signing back in.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop control guidance copy revision on home intro screen: Update the home intro body text to explain system tray access, hiding/showing, and dragging the pet. (why: 3 support emails specifically complained about confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet right after setup.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop status loading animation on waiting screen: Add an animated desktop setup component displaying dynamic pet asset rendering progress. (why: The waiting step has high mean latency (2336s mean), making clear active loading feedback critical to prevent user drop-off.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop companion completion sound notification toggle on waiting screen: Enable optional ready audio notification switch on the desktop waiting screen. (why: Users spend a long time waiting (median 201s / mean 2336s) and often tab away before finishing onboarding.)
